modalLead: Bookmarks gains five summary tiles above the list; Statistics → Overview headline counts stay on one row. Patch series since v2026.08.02 also covers Unraid Tailscale Docker hooks (.1) and Config → Overview status tiles at laptop widths (.2).

items.text: Bookmarks summary tiles — five compact tiles above the list show global totals for bookmarks, tagged (with % of total), categories, shortcuts, and monitored (bookmarksSummaryTiles(), config-tiles--bookmarks).
Statistics overview tiles on one row — the Overview tab reuses the six-column overview grid (config-tiles--overview in renderStatsBody()).
Overview status tiles on one row — delay the three-column breakpoint to 720px (v2026.08.02.2, config-view.css).
Unraid Tailscale hook — entrypoint starts as root so host Docker hooks can run, then drops to nextdash via su-exec (v2026.08.02.1, scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh).

Release docs for v2026.08.02.3 — What's new modal, Config → Overview → Latest update, CHANGELOG, and Config → Help recap; whats-new JSON for hotfixes v2026.08.02.1–.3; DASHBOARD_RELEASE → 2026.07-dashboard-release-v153, NEXTDASH_WHATS_NEW_DATA_VERSION → whats-new-v211.
